rationale: For a mobility and logistics app (GoRide), we need high trust, functional clarity, and high visibility on the road. The Swiss & High-Contrast archetype ensures strong data hierarchy and readability for drivers in sunlight, while bright accents (Taxi Yellow) provide clear calls to action.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter text-slate-950
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Functional utility meets modern brutalism. High density for Admin, generous tap targets for Mobile Customer/Worker apps.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Use rounded-xl for main cards, p-4 to p-6 padding. Avoid soft massive shadows; use 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) with shadow-sm.

grid_strategy.marketing: Asymmetric bento grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8) for feature showcases.
grid_strategy.dashboard_admin: Strict Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6).
grid_strategy.mobile_app: Bottom sheet overlays over a full-bleed Leaflet map. Map must be fixed to background.

components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). CTAs must be highly visible (bg-[#FFCC00] text-black). Include hover states (hover:bg-[#E6B800]) and focus rings.
components.cards: Solid white backgrounds with 1px border. No glassmorphism to maintain strict contrast for map visibility.
components.forms: Inputs should have light gray backgrounds (bg-slate-50) with border-slate-200. Focus should change border to black.
components.map: Leaflet map should use a minimal/light tile layer if possible, avoiding overly cluttered labels to highlight routes and vehicles.

motion.micro_interactions: All buttons should use active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150.
motion.page_transitions: Fade-in for page loads. Slide-up for bottom sheets (mobile map UI).

icons.usage: Use crisp, 2px stroke icons. Keep icon sizes consistent (w-5 h-5 for inline, w-6 h-6 for standalone buttons).

image_urls.description: Three CNG auto rickshaws on a busy tree-lined street, showcasing urban Indian transportation. Use as the main visual for the marketing landing page.
A smiling delivery driver in uniform seated inside his van, holding a smartphone. Use in the Worker/Driver marketing section or onboarding.
Commercial delivery vehicles. Use for the Goods/Logistics feature showcase.

instructions_to_main_agent: Setup Tailwind with the custom color palette and typography specified in this JSON. Import Outfit and IBM Plex Sans in index.html.
Construct a single-page or multi-page app with React Router. Include: Landing Page, Auth Page, Customer Dashboard, Worker Dashboard, and Admin Dashboard.
Mock Auth Flow: Request phone number, then OTP. Accept '123456' as valid. Post-OTP, display a role selection screen (Customer, Worker, Admin).

Customer App: Mobile-first view. Full-screen Leaflet Map. Bottom sliding panel for selecting service (Ride vs Logistics), entering pickup/drop, and showing estimated fares (Bike ₹15-25/km, Auto ₹18/km, Car ₹25-35/km, Tempo ₹40/km, Truck ₹60/km). Simulate live tracking timeline.
Worker App: Toggle for Online/Offline. Incoming request cards with Accept/Reject. 'Worker Wallet' page emphasizing the zero-commission model with flat ₹1 platform fee deduction.
Admin App: Dense data grid layout (Control Room Grid). Show stats for rides, revenue from ₹1 fees, active drivers, and active customers.
CRITICAL: Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements, forms, map markers, and cards (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='role-customer-btn').
